blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — Farmers in this municipality are set to benefit from science-based weather monitoring following the installation and turnover of an automated weather station (AWS) by the Department of Science and Technology (DOST) to the local government on Thursday, November 12. Installed at Sitio Kalagutay, Base Camp, the facility is part of DOST’s Smarter Approaches to Reinvigorate Agriculture as an Industry in the Philippines (SARAI) program.
